runtime: shiny

<!--
Run once:  install.packages(c("shiny", "rmarkdown", "jsonlite", "httr", "rvest", "xml2"))
Then:      rmarkdown::run("nfl-picks-dashboard.Rmd")      (or "Run Document" in RStudio)

Optional, for multi-sportsbook odds: get a free key at https://the-odds-api.com and set it before running:
           Sys.setenv(ODDS_API_KEY = "your-key")          (or put ODDS_API_KEY=... in ~/.Renviron)

Live sources, all keyed to the selected week
  - NFL.com editors   https://www.nfl.com/news/nfl-picks-week-{WEEK}-{SEASON}-nfl-season  (picks + written analysis)
  - CBS Sports        https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/picks/experts/straight-up/{WEEK}/     (7 experts)
  - ESPN              scoreboard feed (schedule, lines, scores) + FPI win probabilities
  - Sportsbooks       The Odds API (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, etc.), averaged
  - picks.csv         optional manual rows (e.g. ESPN's expert picks: columns espn_a, espn_h)
ESPN's picks article can't be scraped: its URL contains a story ID that changes every week and the page
is built with JavaScript. ESPN FPI is used instead, and you can type ESPN's picks into picks.csv.
-->

})

```{r helpers}
# ---- Teams ---------------------------------------------------------------------
teams <- data.frame(
  abbr = c("ARI","ATL","BAL","BUF","CAR","CHI","CIN","CLE","DAL","DEN","DET","GB","HOU","IND","JAX","KC",
           "LAC","LAR","LV","MIA","MIN","NE","NO","NYG","NYJ","PHI","PIT","SEA","SF","TB","TEN","WSH"),
  nick = c("Cardinals","Falcons","Ravens","Bills","Panthers","Bears","Bengals","Browns","Cowboys","Broncos",
           "Lions","Packers","Texans","Colts","Jaguars","Chiefs","Chargers","Rams","Raiders","Dolphins",
           "Vikings","Patriots","Saints","Giants","Jets","Eagles","Steelers","Seahawks","49ers","Buccaneers",
           "Titans","Commanders"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
alias <- c(JAC = "JAX", WAS = "WSH", AZ = "ARI", LA = "LAR", OAK = "LV", SD = "LAC", STL = "LAR")
abbr2nick <- function(a) {
  a <- toupper(a)
  a <- ifelse(a %in% names(alias), unname(alias[a]), a)
  teams$nick[match(a, teams$abbr)]
}

# ---- Standard columns ------------------------------------------------------------
num_cols <- c("week","ml_a","ml_h","spread","total","nfl_a","nfl_h","cbs_a","cbs_h","espn_a","espn_h",
              "score_a","score_h","fpi_a","book_a","book_n")
chr_cols <- c("away","home","away_rec","home_rec","time","fav","why1","why2","why_nfl","books_txt","event_id")

std <- function(d) {
  n <- if (is.null(d)) 0 else nrow(d)
  out <- data.frame(row.names = seq_len(n))
  for (cn in num_cols) out[[cn]] <- if (n && cn %in% names(d)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[cn]])) else rep(NA_real_, n)
  for (cn in chr_cols) out[[cn]] <- if (n && cn %in% names(d)) as.character(d[[cn]]) else rep(NA_character_, n)
  out[, c("week", "away", "home", setdiff(c(num_cols, chr_cols), c("week", "away", "home")))]
}
add_key <- function(d) {
  d$key <- ifelse(d$away < d$home, paste(d$away, d$home, sep = "|"), paste(d$home, d$away, sep = "|"))
  d
}
fill <- function(x, y) ifelse(is.na(x), y, x)

# Flip a/h columns for rows where a source lists the teams in the opposite order (neutral-site games)
swap_rows <- function(s, rows) {
  if (!any(rows)) return(s)
  for (p in list(c("ml_a","ml_h"), c("nfl_a","nfl_h"), c("cbs_a","cbs_h"), c("espn_a","espn_h"),
                 c("score_a","score_h"), c("away_rec","home_rec"))) {
    t <- s[[p[1]]][rows]; s[[p[1]]][rows] <- s[[p[2]]][rows]; s[[p[2]]][rows] <- t
  }
  s$fav[rows] <- ifelse(s$fav[rows] == "a", "h", ifelse(s$fav[rows] == "h", "a", NA))
  for (cn in c("fpi_a", "book_a")) s[[cn]][rows] <- 100 - s[[cn]][rows]
  s
}
# Fill gaps in `base` from `src` (matched by team pair). Earlier sources take priority.
combine <- function(base, src) {
  if (is.null(src) || nrow(src) == 0) return(base)
  src <- add_key(src)
  src <- src[match(base$key, src$key), , drop = FALSE]
  src <- swap_rows(src, !is.na(src$away) & src$away != base$away)
  for (cn in setdiff(c(num_cols, chr_cols), c("week", "away", "home"))) base[[cn]] <- fill(base[[cn]], src[[cn]])
  base
}

# ---- Small cache so changing games/sliders doesn't re-hit the websites ---------------
cache <- new.env(); last <- new.env()
cached <- function(key, ttl, fun) {
  e <- cache[[key]]
  if (!is.null(e) && as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), e$t, units = "secs")) < ttl) return(e$v)
  v <- tryCatch(fun(), error = function(e) NULL)
  cache[[key]] <- list(t = Sys.time(), v = v)
  v
}

get_html <- function(url) {
  r <- tryCatch(httr::GET(url, httr::user_agent("Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/124 Safari/537.36"),
                          httr::timeout(25)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(r) || httr::status_code(r) >= 400) return(NULL)
  httr::content(r, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
}

# ---- Source 1: manual picks.csv (optional) -----------------------------------------------
read_picks <- function(w) {
  if (!file.exists("picks.csv")) return(std(NULL))
  d <- tryCatch(read.csv("picks.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(d)) return(std(NULL))
  d <- std(d)
  d[!is.na(d$week) & d$week == w, , drop = FALSE]
}

# ---- Source 2: ESPN scoreboard (schedule, lines, scores) --------------------------------------
as_num <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v) || length(v) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  v <- as.character(v[[1]])
  if (toupper(v) == "EVEN") return(100)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
}
side_ml <- function(o, side) {
  v <- tryCatch(o$moneyline[[side]]$close$odds, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(v)) v <- tryCatch(o[[paste0(side, "TeamOdds")]]$moneyLine, error = function(e) NULL)
  as_num(v)
}
parse_spread <- function(details, home_abbr, away_abbr) {
  out <- list(fav = NA_character_, spread = NA_real_)
  if (is.null(details) || length(details) == 0 || is.na(details)) return(out)
  if (toupper(details) %in% c("EVEN", "PK", "PICK")) return(list(fav = "h", spread = 0))
  m <- regmatches(details, regexec("^(\\S+)\\s+([-+]?[0-9.]+)$", details))[[1]]
  if (length(m) == 3) {
    out$spread <- abs(as.numeric(m[3]))
    out$fav <- if (m[2] == home_abbr) "h" else if (m[2] == away_abbr) "a" else NA_character_
  }
  out
}
fetch_espn_week <- function(week, year) {
  url <- sprintf("https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/scoreboard?seasontype=2&week=%d&dates=%d", week, year)
  j <- tryCatch(fromJSON(url, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(j) || length(j$events) == 0) return(NULL)
  rows <- lapply(j$events, function(ev) {
    comp <- ev$competitions[[1]]; cs <- comp$competitors
    home <- Filter(function(x) x$homeAway == "home", cs)[[1]]
    away <- Filter(function(x) x$homeAway == "away", cs)[[1]]
    rec <- function(x) if (length(x$records)) x$records[[1]]$summary else NA_character_
    done <- isTRUE(ev$status$type$completed)
    o <- if (length(comp$odds)) comp$odds[[1]] else list()
    sp <- parse_spread(o$details, home$team$abbreviation, away$team$abbreviation)
    t <- as.POSIXct(ev$date, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ", tz = "UTC"); attr(t, "tzone") <- ""
    data.frame(week = week, away = away$team$shortDisplayName, home = home$team$shortDisplayName,
               away_rec = rec(away), home_rec = rec(home), time = format(t, "%a %I:%M %p"),
               ml_a = side_ml(o, "away"), ml_h = side_ml(o, "home"), fav = sp$fav, spread = sp$spread,
               total = if (is.null(o$overUnder)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(o$overUnder),
               score_a = if (done) as.numeric(away$score) else NA_real_,
               score_h = if (done) as.numeric(home$score) else NA_real_,
               event_id = as.character(ev$id), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  std(do.call(rbind, rows))
}
current_week <- function() {
  w <- tryCatch(fromJSON("https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/scoreboard",
                         simplifyVector = FALSE)$week$number, error = function(e) NULL)
  w <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(w))
  if (length(w) != 1 || is.na(w)) 1L else min(max(w, 1L), 18L)
}

# ---- Source 3: ESPN FPI win probability --------------------------------------------------------
fetch_fpi <- function(ids) {
  vapply(ids, function(id) {
    if (is.na(id)) return(NA_real_)
    url <- sprintf("https://sports.core.api.espn.com/v2/sports/football/leagues/nfl/events/%s/competitions/%s/predictor", id, id)
    j <- tryCatch(fromJSON(url, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(j)) return(NA_real_)
    h <- NA_real_
    for (s in j$homeTeam$statistics) if (identical(s$name, "gameProjection")) h <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(s$value))
    if (is.na(h)) NA_real_ else 100 - h          # FPI reports the home team's win probability
  }, numeric(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# ---- Source 4: NFL.com editors' picks + analysis ----------------------------------------------
parse_nfl_chunk <- function(ch) {
  flat <- gsub("\\s+", " ", ch)
  head <- substr(flat, 1, 400)
  m <- regmatches(head, regexec("^\\s*(.+?)\\s+([+-][0-9]+)\\s*\\|\\s*(.+?)\\s+([+-][0-9]+)", head, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  if (length(m) < 5) return(NULL)
  s <- regmatches(head, regexec("SPREAD:\\s*(.+?)\\s+([+-]?[0-9.]+)\\s*\\|\\s*O/U:?\\s*([0-9.]+)", head, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  toks <- regmatches(flat, gregexpr("\\[\\[PICK:[A-Z]+\\]\\]", flat))[[1]]
  nick <- abbr2nick(gsub("\\[\\[PICK:|\\]\\]", "", toks))
  wm <- regmatches(flat, regexec("Why ([A-Za-z]+) picked the ([^:]+):\\s*(.+)$", flat, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  why <- NA_character_
  if (length(wm) == 4) {
    sents <- strsplit(wm[4], "(?<=[.!?])\\s+", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
    txt <- paste(head(sents, 2), collapse = " ")
    if (nchar(txt) > 330) txt <- paste0(substr(txt, 1, 327), "...")
    why <- sprintf("NFL.com's %s on the %s: %s", wm[2], wm[3], txt)
  }
  data.frame(away = m[2], home = m[4], ml_a = as.numeric(m[3]), ml_h = as.numeric(m[5]),
             fav = if (length(s) == 4) (if (s[2] == m[2]) "a" else "h") else NA_character_,
             spread = if (length(s) == 4) abs(as.numeric(s[3])) else NA_real_,
             total = if (length(s) == 4) as.numeric(s[4]) else NA_real_,
             nfl_a = sum(nick == m[2], na.rm = TRUE), nfl_h = sum(nick == m[4], na.rm = TRUE),
             why_nfl = why, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
scrape_nfl <- function(week, year) {
  html <- get_html(sprintf("https://www.nfl.com/news/nfl-picks-week-%d-%d-nfl-season", week, year))
  if (is.null(html)) return(NULL)
  html <- gsub("(?s)<script.*?</script>|<style.*?</style>", " ", html, perl = TRUE)
  html <- gsub("<img[^>]*outlines/([A-Z]{2,3})[^>]*>", " [[PICK:\\1]] ", html, perl = TRUE)  # each pick shows the picked team's outline
  txt <- rvest::html_text2(rvest::html_element(rvest::read_html(html), "body"))
  parts <- strsplit(txt, "MONEYLINE:", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) < 2) return(NULL)
  rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(parts[-1], parse_nfl_chunk))
  if (!length(rows)) return(NULL)
  d <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  d$nfl_a[d$nfl_a + d$nfl_h == 0] <- NA; d$nfl_h[is.na(d$nfl_a)] <- NA   # no picks posted yet
  std(d)
}

# ---- Source 5: CBS Sports expert picks (table rows carry the game and each expert's pick) -----
scrape_cbs <- function(week) {
  html <- get_html(sprintf("https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/picks/experts/straight-up/%d/", week))
  if (is.null(html)) return(NULL)
  doc <- xml2::read_html(html)
  rows <- lapply(xml2::xml_find_all(doc, "//tr"), function(tr) {
    tds <- xml2::xml_find_all(tr, "./td")
    if (length(tds) < 2) return(NULL)
    first <- as.character(tds[[1]])
    m <- regmatches(first, regexec("NFL_[0-9]{8}_([A-Z]+)@([A-Z]+)", first))[[1]]
    if (length(m) < 3) return(NULL)
    away <- abbr2nick(m[2]); home <- abbr2nick(m[3])
    picks <- vapply(seq_along(tds)[-1], function(i) {
      h <- as.character(tds[[i]])
      a <- regmatches(h, regexec("/nfl/teams/([A-Z]+)/", h))[[1]]
      if (length(a) == 2) abbr2nick(a[2]) else NA_character_
    }, character(1))
    ca <- sum(picks == away, na.rm = TRUE); ch <- sum(picks == home, na.rm = TRUE)
    data.frame(away = away, home = home, cbs_a = if (ca + ch) ca else NA_real_,
               cbs_h = if (ca + ch) ch else NA_real_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rows)
  if (!length(rows)) return(NULL)
  std(do.call(rbind, rows))
}

# ---- Source 6: sportsbooks via The Odds API (needs ODDS_API_KEY) --------------------------------
implied <- function(ml) ifelse(ml < 0, -ml / (-ml + 100), 100 / (ml + 100))
fetch_books <- function() {
  key <- Sys.getenv("ODDS_API_KEY")
  if (!nzchar(key)) return(NULL)
  url <- sprintf("https://api.the-odds-api.com/v4/sports/americanfootball_nfl/odds/?apiKey=%s&regions=us&markets=h2h&oddsFormat=american", key)
  j <- fromJSON(url, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  rows <- lapply(j, function(ev) {
    ps <- lapply(ev$bookmakers, function(b) {
      mk <- Filter(function(m) m$key == "h2h", b$markets)
      if (!length(mk)) return(NULL)
      o <- mk[[1]]$outcomes
      pa <- Filter(function(x) x$name == ev$away_team, o); ph <- Filter(function(x) x$name == ev$home_team, o)
      if (!length(pa) || !length(ph)) return(NULL)
      ia <- implied(pa[[1]]$price); ih <- implied(ph[[1]]$price)
      list(p = ia / (ia + ih) * 100, title = b$title)        # margin removed per book
    })
    ps <- Filter(Negate(is.null), ps)
    if (!length(ps)) return(NULL)
    p <- vapply(ps, function(x) x$p, numeric(1)); ti <- vapply(ps, function(x) x$title, character(1))
    data.frame(away = sub(".* ", "", ev$away_team), home = sub(".* ", "", ev$home_team),
               book_a = mean(p), book_n = length(p),
               books_txt = paste(sprintf("%s %.0f%%", ti, p), collapse = ", "), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rows)
  if (!length(rows)) return(NULL)
  std(do.call(rbind, rows))
}

# ---- Consensus -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
fmt_ml <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "-", ifelse(x > 0, paste0("+", x), as.character(x)))
n0 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x)

calc <- function(d, w) {
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(d)
  has_ml <- !is.na(d$ml_a) & !is.na(d$ml_h)
  ia <- implied(d$ml_a); ih <- implied(d$ml_h)
  p_ml <- ia / (ia + ih) * 100
  pf <- pnorm(d$spread / 13.5) * 100                                  # fallback: spread -> favorite win chance
  p_sp <- ifelse(is.na(d$fav), NA_real_, ifelse(d$fav == "a", pf, 100 - pf))
  d$p_mkt <- ifelse(!is.na(d$book_a), d$book_a, ifelse(has_ml, p_ml, p_sp))
  d$mkt_src <- ifelse(!is.na(d$book_a), paste0("average of ", d$book_n, " sportsbooks"),
                      ifelse(has_ml, "moneyline", ifelse(is.na(p_sp), "none", "point spread")))
  # Expert picks become a probability with a small prior so 5-0 isn't treated as 100%
  share <- function(a, h) ifelse(is.na(a) & is.na(h), NA_real_, (n0(a) + 1) / (n0(a) + n0(h) + 2) * 100)
  d$p_nfl <- share(d$nfl_a, d$nfl_h); d$p_cbs <- share(d$cbs_a, d$cbs_h); d$p_espn <- share(d$espn_a, d$espn_h)
  P <- cbind(nfl = d$p_nfl, cbs = d$p_cbs, espn = d$p_espn, fpi = d$fpi_a, mkt = d$p_mkt)
  W <- matrix(w[colnames(P)], nrow = nrow(P), ncol = ncol(P), byrow = TRUE)
  ok <- !is.na(P)
  num <- rowSums(ifelse(ok, P * W, 0)); den <- rowSums(ifelse(ok, W, 0))
  d$p_away <- ifelse(den > 0, num / den, 50)
  d$p_home <- 100 - d$p_away
  d$n_src <- rowSums(ok & W > 0)
  d$has_votes <- !(is.na(d$nfl_a) & is.na(d$nfl_h) & is.na(d$cbs_a) & is.na(d$cbs_h) & is.na(d$espn_a) & is.na(d$espn_h))
  d$votes_a <- ifelse(d$has_votes, rowSums(cbind(d$nfl_a, d$cbs_a, d$espn_a), na.rm = TRUE), NA)
  d$votes_h <- ifelse(d$has_votes, rowSums(cbind(d$nfl_h, d$cbs_h, d$espn_h), na.rm = TRUE), NA)
  d$final   <- !is.na(d$score_a) & !is.na(d$score_h)
  d$winner  <- ifelse(!d$final, NA, ifelse(d$score_a > d$score_h, "a", "h"))
  d$cons_fav <- ifelse(d$n_src == 0 | d$p_away == 50, NA, ifelse(d$p_away > 50, "a", "h"))
  d$mkt_fav  <- ifelse(is.na(d$p_mkt) | d$p_mkt == 50, NA, ifelse(d$p_mkt > 50, "a", "h"))
  d$exp_fav  <- ifelse(!d$has_votes | d$votes_a == d$votes_h, NA, ifelse(d$votes_a > d$votes_h, "a", "h"))
  d$pick  <- ifelse(is.na(d$cons_fav), "Toss-up", ifelse(d$cons_fav == "a", d$away, d$home))
  d$label <- paste(d$away, "at", d$home)
  d
}
sp_txt <- function(r, side) {
  if (is.na(r$spread) || is.na(r$fav)) return("-")
  if (r$fav == side) paste0("-", r$spread) else paste0("+", r$spread)
}
```

Consensus pick = weighted average of every source's win probability for each team. Expert picks from NFL.com,
CBS Sports and ESPN are converted to a probability from their vote split, then averaged with ESPN FPI and the
sportsbook line. Use the sliders to change how much each source counts (0 turns a source off). For information only,
not betting advice.

```{r controls}
auto_timer <- reactiveTimer(10 * 60 * 1000)

wk <- reactive({
  input$refresh
  if (isTRUE(input$auto)) auto_timer()
  w <- as.integer(input$week); req(w)
  if (!identical(input$refresh, last$refresh)) { rm(list = ls(cache), envir = cache); last$refresh <- input$refresh }

  espn  <- cached(paste("espn", w), 120, function() fetch_espn_week(w, season))
  nfl   <- cached(paste("nfl", w), 600, function() scrape_nfl(w, season))
  cbs   <- cached(paste("cbs", w), 600, function() scrape_cbs(w))
  books <- cached("books", 300, fetch_books)
  cur   <- read_picks(w)

  base <- NULL
  for (s in list(espn, nfl, cbs, cur)) if (is.null(base) && !is.null(s) && nrow(s) > 0) base <- s
  stat <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) "not available" else paste(nrow(x), "games")
  fp <- NULL
  if (!is.null(base)) {
    base <- add_key(base); base$week <- w
    fp <- cached(paste("fpi", w), 600, function() fetch_fpi(base$event_id))
    for (s in list(nfl, cbs, books, cur)) base <- combine(base, s)
    if (!is.null(fp) && length(fp) == nrow(base)) base$fpi_a <- fill(base$fpi_a, fp)
  }
  st <- data.frame(
    Source = c("ESPN scoreboard (schedule, lines, scores)", "NFL.com editors + analysis", "CBS Sports experts",
               "ESPN FPI win probability", "Sportsbooks (The Odds API)", "picks.csv (manual)"),
    Status = c(stat(espn), stat(nfl), stat(cbs),
               if (!is.null(fp) && any(!is.na(fp))) paste(sum(!is.na(fp)), "games") else "not available",
               if (!nzchar(Sys.getenv("ODDS_API_KEY"))) "no ODDS_API_KEY set" else stat(books), stat(cur)))
  wt <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) 1 else x
  weights <- c(nfl = wt(input$w_nfl), cbs = wt(input$w_cbs), espn = wt(input$w_espn),
               fpi = wt(input$w_fpi), mkt = wt(input$w_mkt))
  d <- if (is.null(base)) std(NULL) else calc(base, weights)
  attr(d, "status") <- st
  d
})

inputPanel(
  selectInput("week", "Week", choices = 1:18, selected = current_week()),
  actionButton("refresh", "Refresh data"),
  checkboxInput("auto", "Auto-refresh every 10 min", FALSE),
  renderUI({
    d <- wk()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(helpText("No games found for this week."))
    selectInput("game", "Game", choices = setNames(seq_len(nrow(d)), d$label))
  })
)
inputPanel(
  sliderInput("w_nfl", "NFL.com weight", 0, 3, 1, step = 0.5),
  sliderInput("w_cbs", "CBS Sports weight", 0, 3, 1, step = 0.5),
  sliderInput("w_espn", "ESPN picks weight", 0, 3, 1, step = 0.5),
  sliderInput("w_fpi", "ESPN FPI weight", 0, 3, 1, step = 0.5),
  sliderInput("w_mkt", "Sportsbooks weight", 0, 3, 1, step = 0.5)
)
```

```{r summary}
renderUI({
  d <- wk()
  if (nrow(d) == 0)
    return(div(class = "panel-box", "No schedule or picks could be loaded for this week. Check your connection, then click Refresh data."))
  rec <- function(col) {
    ok <- d$final & !is.na(d[[col]])
    if (!any(ok)) return("-")
    paste0(sum(d[[col]][ok] == d$winner[ok]), "-", sum(d[[col]][ok] != d$winner[ok]))
  }
  div(class = "sum",
      div(tags$b(nrow(d)), "games"),
      div(tags$b(rec("cons_fav")), "consensus pick (final games)"),
      div(tags$b(rec("mkt_fav")), "sportsbook favorite"),
      div(tags$b(rec("exp_fav")), "expert majority"))
})
```

```{r detail}
renderUI({
  d <- wk(); req(nrow(d) > 0, input$game)
  idx <- as.integer(input$game); req(idx >= 1, idx <= nrow(d))
  r <- d[idx, ]
  lead_p <- max(r$p_away, r$p_home)

  # Per-source breakdown
  src <- list(
    list("NFL.com editors", sprintf("%s-%s picks", n0(r$nfl_a), n0(r$nfl_h)), r$p_nfl),
    list("CBS Sports experts", sprintf("%s-%s picks", n0(r$cbs_a), n0(r$cbs_h)), r$p_cbs),
    list("ESPN picks (picks.csv)", sprintf("%s-%s picks", n0(r$espn_a), n0(r$espn_h)), r$p_espn),
    list("ESPN FPI", "win probability", r$fpi_a),
    list("Sportsbooks", r$mkt_src, r$p_mkt))
  src <- Filter(function(x) !is.na(x[[3]]), src)
  pa <- vapply(src, function(x) x[[3]], numeric(1))
  agree <- if (is.na(r$cons_fav)) NA else if (r$cons_fav == "a") sum(pa > 50) else sum(pa < 50)

  result <- if (r$final) {
    w <- if (r$winner == "a") r$away else r$home
    chk <- function(f, lab) if (is.na(f)) NULL else
      tagList(sprintf(" %s ", lab), span(class = if (f == r$winner) "hit" else "miss", if (f == r$winner) "right" else "wrong"), ".")
    div(class = "res", sprintf("Final: %s %d, %s %d. %s won.", r$away, r$score_a, r$home, r$score_h, w),
        chk(r$cons_fav, "Consensus pick was"), chk(r$mkt_fav, "Sportsbook favorite was"), chk(r$exp_fav, "Expert majority was"))
  } else div(class = "res", paste(if (is.na(r$time)) "Upcoming" else r$time, "- not final"))

  # Reasons: live NFL.com analysis and any manual notes; otherwise computed from the data
  bullets <- c(r$why_nfl, r$why1, r$why2)
  bullets <- bullets[!is.na(bullets)]
  if (!is.na(r$away_rec) && !is.na(r$home_rec))
    bullets <- c(bullets, sprintf("Records: %s %s, %s %s.", r$away, r$away_rec, r$home, r$home_rec))
  if (!is.na(r$spread) && !is.na(r$total) && !is.na(r$fav)) {
    fav_n <- if (r$fav == "a") r$away else r$home; dog_n <- if (r$fav == "a") r$home else r$away
    bullets <- c(bullets, sprintf("Spread %s -%.1f with a %.1f total implies about %s %.1f, %s %.1f.",
                                  fav_n, r$spread, r$total, fav_n, (r$total + r$spread) / 2, dog_n, (r$total - r$spread) / 2))
  }
  if (!is.na(agree)) bullets <- c(sprintf("%d of %d sources lean %s.", agree, length(src), r$pick), bullets)
  if (length(bullets) == 0) bullets <- "No analysis available yet for this game."

  div(class = "panel-box",
    div(class = "big",
      div(div(class = "n", style = "color:#1f6b4a", sprintf("%.1f%%", r$p_away)),
          div(class = "tag", paste0(r$away, if (is.na(r$away_rec)) "" else paste0(" (", r$away_rec, ")")))),
      div(style = "text-align:right",
          div(class = "n", style = "color:#2b4c7e", sprintf("%.1f%%", r$p_home)),
          div(class = "tag", paste0(r$home, if (is.na(r$home_rec)) "" else paste0(" (", r$home_rec, ")"))))),
    div(class = "bar", tags$i(class = "a", style = sprintf("width:%f%%", r$p_away)),
                       tags$i(class = "b", style = sprintf("width:%f%%", r$p_home))),
    div(class = "pick", if (is.na(r$cons_fav)) "Consensus: toss-up (not enough data yet)"
                        else sprintf("Consensus pick: %s (%.0f%%)", r$pick, lead_p)),
    result,
    h2("Why"), tags$ul(lapply(bullets, tags$li)),
    h2("Source breakdown"),
    if (length(src) == 0) div(class = "tag", "No sources have data for this game yet.") else
      tags$table(
        tags$tr(tags$th("Source"), tags$th("Detail"), tags$th(r$away), tags$th(r$home), tags$th("Leans")),
        lapply(src, function(x) tags$tr(tags$td(x[[1]]), tags$td(x[[2]]), tags$td(sprintf("%.0f%%", x[[3]])),
                                        tags$td(sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 - x[[3]])),
                                        tags$td(if (x[[3]] > 50) r$away else if (x[[3]] < 50) r$home else "even")))),
    h2("Lines"),
    tags$table(
      tags$tr(tags$th(""), tags$th("Moneyline"), tags$th("Spread")),
      tags$tr(tags$td(r$away), tags$td(fmt_ml(r$ml_a)), tags$td(sp_txt(r, "a"))),
      tags$tr(tags$td(r$home), tags$td(fmt_ml(r$ml_h)), tags$td(sp_txt(r, "h")))),
    div(class = "tag", if (is.na(r$total)) "Total: -" else sprintf("Total %.1f.", r$total),
        if (!is.na(r$books_txt)) paste0(" Sportsbook win chance for ", r$away, ": ", r$books_txt, ".")))
})
```

## Full slate

```{r slate}
renderTable({
  d <- wk(); req(nrow(d) > 0)
  data.frame(Game = d$label, Time = ifelse(is.na(d$time), "", d$time),
             `Consensus pick` = d$pick,
             `Pick %` = round(pmax(d$p_away, d$p_home), 0),
             `Book %` = ifelse(is.na(d$p_mkt) | is.na(d$cons_fav), "-",
                               as.character(round(ifelse(d$cons_fav == "h", 100 - d$p_mkt, d$p_mkt), 0))),
             Sources = d$n_src,
             Final = ifelse(d$final, paste0(d$score_a, "-", d$score_h), ""),
             check.names = FALSE)
}, striped = TRUE)
```
